payload.text: Run one bats suite at a time on this machine: agents.bats tests for molt agent start read the real process table, so a second run sees the first ones stand-in session (moltstart-sysadm is already running), until vc moves the stubs into test_helper.bash. Verify a commit against a scratch export of HEAD plus your files (git init it for the no-Python test), not the shared tree a peer is editing.
